note: Santa Clarita is a general law, council-manager city with a five-member council (City Candidate Handbook, form of government, page 3). The official city council page (opened) says the five-person council designates one of its members to serve as Mayor at the first meeting in December each year. The Handbook election calendar lists a council reorganization where the council selects mayor and mayor pro tem. No mayoral election appears on this basis; the office is filled by council selection. The archived official council page of February 2010 (opened) lists Mayor Laurene Weste and Mayor Pro-Tem Marsha McLean as council members with no selection rule stated. The period-specific statute text (California Government Code 36801) could not be opened: leginfo returned HTTP 403 and the archive copy failed. The rule is therefore taken from current official city pages and applied to this year on the basis that the city has been a general law city with council selection; no direct mayoral election was found.
